claim: A Firewall Manager policy is specific to one policy type (AWS WAF, Shield Advanced, security group, network ACL, Network Firewall, DNS Firewall or third-party firewall); to enforce several types you create several policies, and you can create more than one policy per type.
question: Can one Firewall Manager policy cover both AWS WAF and security groups?

values.display: specific to the individual policy type
you can create multiple policies

evidence.quote: A Firewall Manager policy is specific to the individual policy type. If you want to enforce multiple policy types across accounts, you can create multiple policies. You can create more than one policy for each type.

evidence.quote: **AWS WAF** **policy** – Firewall Manager supports AWS WAF and AWS WAF Classic policies.

evidence.quote: **Shield Advanced policy** – This policy type applies Shield Advanced protections throughout your organization for the resource types that you specify.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies

evidence.quote: **Amazon VPC security group policy** – This policy type gives you control over security groups that are in use throughout your organization and lets you enforce a baseline set of rules across your organization.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies

evidence.quote: **Amazon VPC network access control list (ACL) policy** – This policy type gives you control over network ACLs that are in use throughout your organization and lets you enforce a baseline set of network ACLs across your organization.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies

evidence.quote: **Network Firewall policy** – This policy type applies AWS Network Firewall protection to your organization's VPCs.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies

evidence.quote: **Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall policy** – This policy applies DNS Firewall protections to your organization's VPCs.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies

evidence.quote: **Third-party firewall policy** – This policy type applies third-party firewall protections.
evidence.title: Using AWS Firewall Manager policies
